card.name: Start of words beginning with Di-
card.fires_on: The word-start "di" or "Di" when it begins a longer word such as diarrhea, diaper, diaries or diaphoresis. It is strongest at the start of a word after a heading or list dash.

modes.label: Diarrhea heading
modes.description: "Di" starting the word diarrhea in adverse-reaction or dose-modification headings.
modes.example: 5.4 Severe or Persistent<< Di>>arrhea Grade 3 or 4

modes.label: Other di- words
modes.description: "di" starting diaries, diaper or diaphoresis in ordinary or clinical text.
modes.example: Cotton swabs -<< Di>>aper rash ointment - B

card.writes: It promotes odd unrelated tokens and suppresses further "di" pieces, so it seems to discourage repeating the Di start.
card.plain: It fires on the first letters "Di" at the start of words like diarrhea, diaper and diaries.
